title: Seagrove Beach "Feeling Tipsea" 67 Montigo Avenue
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private heated saltwater pool with sitting spa and swim-up bar **Pool heating is available Oct 1-May 1 for $65 per day** The pool and spa are heated together.- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Rooftop patio with Gulf views- Firetable- Gas fireplace- Grill- Garage- 8 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience a luxurious coastal escape at Feeling Tipsea, an 8-bedroom, 8-bathroom Seagrove Beach home that sleeps 26. Nestled within the Emerald Coast, this quintessential beach town has everything guests need for a delightful vacation. Enjoy sun-drenched days cooling off in the saltwater pool, sipping drinks at the swim-up bar, or strolling to the beach—5 minutes away!A serene interior of sea-inspired accents and white shiplap walls welcomes guests inside this 4-level abode. Prepare for laid-back competition in the game room, featuring a wet bar, 75” Smart TV, 5-person table, and a pool table. Out the sliding glass doors, an oversized private pool with deck seating, a swim-up bar, and a barbecue area with 2 outdoor tables seating 8 total encourages sun-fueled fun. When evening falls, retire to the guest bedroom with a king bed. Off the game room is a cozy sleeping area with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, which connects to the convenient laundry room.Take the stairs or the in-home elevator to the open-concept great room boasting 12-foot ceilings and oak wood floors on the second level. The thoughtfully furnished living area has 2 leather couches and 2 armchairs flanking a 75” Smart TV for movie nights. Continue past the 10-person dining table to find an enormous gourmet kitchen with Miele appliances and an island that seats 3. Outside, a 6-person table and soft seating are on the spacious balcony. Sleeping accommodations on this floor include a luxurious primary bedroom with 1 king bed and a bunk room with 1 queen-over-queen bed and 2 twin-over-twin beds.A second primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom awaits on the third level. Additionally, there are 3 guest bedrooms with king beds—the last has an extra twin-over-twin bunk bed.Venture to the rooftop patio and indulge in cocktails around the 5-person table as the sun sets over the Gulf.Feeling Tipsea’s private pool, quick beach access, and outdoor spaces make for a perfect Seagrove Beach retreat! Easily explore with parking for 6 vehicles—plus 8 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle. The nearest beach access is Santa Clara Regional, a 5-minute stroll away. Book this gorgeous home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 26):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 4 Twin XL Beds- Hallway Bathroom: Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed and 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds - Hallway Bathroom: Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin XL-over-Twin XL Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboFOURTH FLOOR:- Rooftop Patio

Nestled within the Emerald Coast, this quintessential beach town has everything guests need for a delightful vacation. Enjoy sun-drenched days cooling off in the saltwater pool, sipping drinks at the swim-up bar, or strolling to the beach—5 minutes away! A serene interior of sea-inspired accents and white shiplap walls welcomes guests inside this 4-level abode. Prepare for laid-back competition in the game room, featuring a wet bar, 75” Smart TV, 5-person table, and a pool table. Out the sliding glass doors, an oversized private pool with deck seating, a swim-up bar, and a barbecue area with 2 outdoor tables seating 8 total encourages sun-fueled fun. When evening falls, retire to the guest bedroom with a king bed. Off the game room is a cozy sleeping area with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, which connects to the convenient laundry room. Take the stairs or the in-home elevator to the open-concept great room boasting 12-foot ceilings and oak wood floors on the second level. The thoughtfully furnished living area has 2 leather couches and 2 armchairs flanking a 75” Smart TV for movie nights. Sleeping accommodations on this floor include a luxurious primary bedroom with 1 king bed and a bunk room with 1 queen-over-queen bed and 2 twin-over-twin beds. A second primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom awaits on the third level. Additionally, there are 3 guest bedrooms with king beds—the last has an extra twin-over-twin bunk bed. Venture to the rooftop patio and indulge in cocktails around the 5-person table as the sun sets over the Gulf. Feeling Tipsea’s private pool, quick beach access, and outdoor spaces make for a perfect Seagrove Beach retreat! Easily explore with parking for 6 vehicles—plus 8 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle. The nearest beach access is Santa Clara Regional, a 5-minute stroll away. Book this gorgeous home today!
